thread:
Maya Singh: quick sync notes 1 proposal: a lightweight hedge-controller between gatekeeper and router to translate decisions into timed, idempotent enforcement steps. keeps rollbacks gradual and auditable.
Arjun Rao: +1. controller should emit timeboxed instructions: decision_id, seq, target_fraction, expires_at. router applies only if seq > last_seq.
Elena Gomez: require signal fusion before major escalation (eg p95+error_rate or drift+quality_drop). also suggest default local scope up to 30% soft-degrade, global sign-off for >30%.
Maya Singh: add safety budgets per-tenant: tokens proportional to healthy traffic, consumed by hedges. if budget exhausted escalate.
fallback-bot: staging: tenant="gamma" applied hedge [80,50,20] with jitter 0-20s, decision_id=dec-2087-01
Arjun Rao: implement lease-based leader per-region for deterministic owner. router must honor TTL and revert when expired. add jitter on ramps.
Elena Gomez: policy DSL sketch (YAML string in RFC): scope, max_soft_fraction, steps, consecutive_windows, cooldown_secs, required_signals.
Maya Singh: test plan: unit+integration+chaos (observer loss, clock skew, partial partition). metrics: decisions_per_min, avg_signal_to_decision_ms, hedge_success_rate, budget_consumed. I'll draft RFC this week.
